entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for an order I placed a while back. My order number is VF88301.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order VF88301... Okay, I see the order here for a VeloFit Performance jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference issue. I ordered the jersey and it turned out to be the wrong size. It's just too tight for a comfortable ride, and I was hoping to start a return or an exchange.

I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 83 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.

That's great news, thank you. Now, since I've had it for a bit and will have to go through the hassle of packaging and shipping it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my trouble? Maybe for my next purchase?

I appreciate you asking. While I can't offer a discount code for a standard return, I can confirm that the return shipping is completely free. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now, so there will be no cost on your end to send the jersey back for a full refund.

Okay, I see. How about this then, to save VeloFit the cost of return shipping, what if you gave me a partial store credit, and I just keep the item? I could probably gift the jersey to someone since it's the wrong size for me.

That's a thoughtful offer, but our system is set up to process full returns to ensure the product can be properly inspected. We don't have a process for partial credits on fit-related issues. The best and only path forward is the full refund once we receive the item. The label is already in your inbox.
Alright, I had to try. A full refund is fine. Thanks for looking into it for me, David. I appreciate the help with the exchange process.

You're very welcome. Just print that label, attach it to the package, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
